title: Miscellaneous Utilities
summary: This module provides a collection of general-purpose utility functions, including file downloading, development decorators, and dummy implementations for testing language models and retrievers.

nodes.label: Download File
nodes.title: Download Files from URL
nodes.description: Downloads a file from a given URL, checking if it already exists and its size to avoid re-downloading unnecessary data.

nodes.label: Mark Experimental Features
nodes.title: Decorator for Experimental Code
nodes.description: A decorator used to mark functions or classes as experimental, providing a mechanism for managing feature development and deprecation.

nodes.label: Dummy Language Model
nodes.title: Simulate LM for Testing
nodes.description: Provides a mock language model for unit testing, supporting various response modes like predefined lists, dictionary lookups, or example following to simulate LM behavior without actual API calls.

nodes.label: Dummy Retriever Logic
nodes.title: Simulate Retrieval Logic
nodes.description: An internal function within a dummy retriever (likely `DummyRM` not shown here) that simulates document retrieval based on vector similarity for testing purposes.

nodes.label: Base LM Interface
nodes.title: Base Language Model Interface
nodes.description: The foundational abstract class for all language models in DSPy, defining the common interface for LM operations.

nodes.label: Chat Adapter
nodes.title: Format Chat Messages
nodes.description: Adapts messages and responses to and from a chat-based language model format, handling roles and content structuring.

nodes.label: Requests Library
nodes.title: HTTP Request Utility
nodes.description: A popular Python library for making HTTP requests, used by the download utility for fetching files from the web.

groups.label: Testing Tools
groups.title: Testing and Mocking Utilities
groups.description: Contains components for simulating external systems like Language Models and Retrievers, crucial for unit testing and development without external dependencies.

groups.label: File Management
groups.title: File Download Utility
groups.description: Provides a utility function for downloading files from URLs, with checks to prevent redundant downloads.

groups.label: Development Tools
groups.title: Developer Annotation Tools
groups.description: Includes decorators for marking code components, such as indicating experimental features, aiding in code maintenance and communication.
